_comment: Daily habit tracker (see notify_watcher/topics/habits.py). Each habit: name (unique id, also its state key and the DONE:<name> command target), title (push title - keep the habit name in it), tag (emoji tag), times (LOCAL Dominican Republic times, 'HH:MM' 24h; DR is UTC+utc_offset_hours year-round, no DST). A slot fires on the first watch run AT or AFTER its time - the habits topic rides the 15-minute fast lane, so reminders land within ~15 min of schedule. At most one push per slot per day, deduped in state. Every reminder posts to the habits Discord channel with a bot-added checkmark reaction: tap the reaction (or the Done button) and the next sweep logs the completion with a timestamp in state.json (habit_log) and silences that habit's remaining reminders for the day. messages rotate per slot for variety; optional enabled (default true) and priority ('high' rings through quiet hours). Adding or re-timing a habit is just an edit here - no code change. Edit this file directly on github.com.

habits.name: water
habits.title: Water - start the day hydrated
messages: Good morning! First glass of water before anything else.
Start the day right: drink a full glass of water now.
Water first, everything else after. Your body spent all night without it.
Morning hydration check: one big glass of water to wake up your system.
Before coffee, before your phone: a glass of water.

habits.name: exercise
habits.title: Exercise - 6 PM session
messages: 6 PM: time to move. Even 20 minutes counts.
Exercise time. Get the body working before the evening slips away.
Workout window is open: stretch, lift, walk - whatever gets you moving.
Your 6 PM exercise slot is here. Future you says thanks.
Time to train. Start small if you have to - just start.

habits.name: meditate
habits.title: Meditate - evening reset
messages: Take 10 quiet minutes to meditate and reset.
Meditation time: sit, breathe, let the day settle.
Pause for meditation - a few minutes of stillness changes the whole evening.
Evening reset: close your eyes and focus on your breath for a while.
Time to meditate. No pressure, just presence.

habits.name: cleaning
habits.title: Cleaning - quick tidy-up
messages: Quick tidy-up time: 15 minutes on the messiest spot.
Cleaning slot: reset one area before the night starts.
A little cleaning now beats a big cleaning later. Pick one thing.
Tidy-up reminder: dishes, desk, or floor - choose one and clear it.
15-minute cleaning sprint. Timer on, go.

habits.name: sleep
habits.title: Sleep - wind down
messages: 9 PM: start winding down. Screens dimmer, lights lower.
Wind-down time: wrap up what you're doing and ease toward bed.
Sleep prep: last call for screens - your bedtime is coming up.
Second call: time to actually head to bed. Tomorrow starts tonight.
Lights out soon. Put the day down - it will be there tomorrow.
Bedtime. Phone away, eyes closed. Good night!
